MOD2 = 998244353

def dfs1(x, length):

def lower_bound(arr, target):
    left, right = 0, len(arr)
    while left < right:
        mid = (left + right) // 2
        if arr[mid] < target:
            left = mid + 1
        else:
            right = mid
    return left

def dfs2(x):
    global ord, ans, sum_list, v
    if x > n:
        return
    if x * base + base - 1 <= n and x * base * 10 > n:
        now = ord
        for i in range(7):
            sz = len(v[i])
            dif = ((now - x * (10 ** i)) % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2
            pos = lower_bound(v[i], (MOD2 - dif) % MOD2)
            ans = (ans + dif * sz + sum_list[i]) % MOD1
            ans = (ans - (MOD1 * (sz - pos) % MOD1)) % MOD1
            ord += sz
        return
    ord += 1
    dif = ((ord - x) % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2
    ans = (ans + dif) % MOD1
    for i in range(10):
        dfs2(x * 10 + i)
